answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 4 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 36 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A onyx that can be verified, a garden that can be measured, and a voyage that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
